reviews.title: Worst company ever
reviews.text: Worst company ever! A company that is 24 hours late on its flights, no one to inform travellers of the arrival time. The result: a hundred people spending the night in Tunis airport, including hospitalized people and disabled children. Absolutely no representative of the company to give news. Shameful company, no ethics and no consideration for human beings.

reviews.text: Hi everybody it's me again I have flown with Libyan Airlines many times with my wife with kids, to Istanbul, Jeddah, Cairo, Algeria, Casablanca, London, Tunis, Rome, Amsterdam, and domestic flights,airbus 320,330. The service was good and staff always smiling, I'm always pleased with the service that I really enjoyed. The food is better quality But now the country is going through difficult circumstances and yet Libyan airlines is still struggling, I recommend this airlines and the price was also very affordable. Keep it up..... Salah
reviews.author: SALAH M

reviews.title: Non-stop smoking!
reviews.text: Libyan Airline is trudging on despite the sorry state of the country and the fleet full of old planes. Slight delays are a routine occurrence but I'm alright with that. The food on-board is moderately fine but passable. What is unbearable is stench of cigarette smoke that quickly fills the interior of a flight as soon as the "No Smoking" sign is turned off. It is so strong that I can't stand it and I find it so revolting that it makes me want to throw-up most of the time. If the air conditioning were cranked up, perhaps this might be prevented. Otherwise there is not much to complain about this airline.
reviews.author: One_Bangali

reviews.title: Delay and bored staff
reviews.text: We traveled from Tunis to Monastir Airport by bus and arrived three hours before departure. But instead of waiting 3 hours, we waited 6 hours.. 3 hrs delay and we were sooo tired. After having my meal, and the crew started to get back the empty plastic meal boxes, I asked the staff to put my used tissue in the trolley but she was tough and answered: Hmmm OK... I was so patient and didn't react. For me, as a long man, usually I ask the counter to get a seat in Emergency Exit Seats so I always have a large area for my legs.

reviews.title: ON A WING AND A PRAY
reviews.text: I could not catch the regular Boing 737 or maybe 727 flight to Sebha, and elected to take instead a Fokker Frienship that was hopping its way down to Sebha. Upon landing at one of a number of Bedouin outposts in the desert, distinguished only by an oasis, the left-hand tyre gave out. We waited by the aircraft, for what seemed an eternity, in the shade of the wings and eventually someone emerged with a replacement wheel and tyre. No big deal........ and off we went on our merry ways. Another memolrable flight.
reviews.author: kelvinwilliama2014
